development_baseline.name: v12 development predictions
development_baseline.recipe: v9 + 1.0 * v12 development residual (runs/adsb_v12_v2/development_residuals.parquet, nb_no_lirf_100, leave-one-month-out), floored; reproduces 332.993 / 274.585 / 198.544 on Jan / Jul / Nov 2025

configuration.development_scheme: leave-one-month-out over the three scoring months that hold out-of-sample v9 predictions (Jan and Jul 2025 from the seasonal fold, Nov 2025 from the forward fold); for each variant (scope, feature set) the residual model is fitted on the other two months' in-scope rows and applied to the held-out month's in-scope rows; every other row keeps v9

external_data.extraction: tools/adsb_extract_day.py keeps positions inside the ten aerodrome boxes that are on the ground or below 3,000 ft; per-day parquet with archive part hashes under data/external/adsblol/surface/ (the tool now skips and counts a corrupt archive member instead of aborting the day; the surface files used here predate that change and are unaffected)
external_data.license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; feeder data CC0; licence files are inside every archive
external_data.matching: tools/build_adsb_features.py: ICAO callsign (CALLSIGN_flt, else FLIGHT_mvt) and takeoff within the track's ground-to-air transition; stand positions learned label-free from covered segments of Jan/Mar/Apr/Jul/Nov 2025 (1,111 stands); the pass-2 matches and stands are exactly the v11 inputs, snapshotted under data/external/adsblol/matches_v11/ and hash-bound below
external_data.source: adsb.lol globe_history daily archives (GitHub releases adsblol/globe_history_2025 and globe_history_2026, tags vYYYY.MM.DD-planes-readsb-prod-0)

adsb_full.description: tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py: per-row mean of the finite predictions of the no-LIRF full-data learners runs/adsb_full_nolirf, runs/adsb_full_cat (LightGBM label target, LightGBM NM-residual target on clock-available rows, CatBoost label target; all on the timeline bundle's 276 model features plus the 27 ADS-B features, fitted without LIRF rows; seasonal/forward folds out-of-sample, refits on the eleven 2025 months for the ranking).

configuration.floor_seconds_rule: minimum departure label over the refit months (-12), applied after the residual

incumbent.recipe: v12 = v9 + 1.0 * ADS-B surface residual with neighbour features on matched rows outside LIRF (configs/adsb_v12_v2.json, nb_no_lirf_100)

configuration.prior_evidence: Declared after v12 (official 246.4831, 3rd) and after adsb_v12_v4 selected blend_all_30 with the LightGBM learner alone (-0.35% / -0.26% / -1.40% versus v12; exported as v13, not uploaded). Before this declaration, descriptive full-month blends of the recorded v12 development predictions with the learners' out-of-sample fold predictions on non-LIRF rows gave, versus v12: LightGBM at w=0.3/0.4/0.5: -0.35/-0.35/-0.28% (Jan), -0.26/-0.19/-0.05% (Jul), -1.40/-1.59/-1.64% (Nov); CatBoost: -0.45/-0.49/-0.46%, -0.55/-0.59/-0.56%, -1.51/-1.73/-1.81%; their mean: -0.46/-0.52/-0.54%, -0.50/-0.55/-0.56%, -1.59/-1.90/-2.10%. The two learners correlate at 0.982 on Nov. The candidates therefore blend the mean of the two label learners at w = 0.3, 0.4, 0.5 and 0.6 on all non-LIRF rows, and at 0.5 on matched rows only; the v12 residual model is refitted inside the run exactly as in v12_v2/v12_v4. Expected size on the ranking: 0.8-2%.

residual_model.applies_to: the residual model is exactly v12's (nb feature set, matched rows outside LIRF, weight 1.0); each candidate then blends the result with the full-data learner's prediction, value = (1 - w) * (v9 + residual) + w * adsb_full, on the candidate's blend scope (matched rows outside LIRF, or every row outside LIRF); rows outside both scopes keep v9 exactly. The learner prediction is never a residual feature (v12_v3 showed that a learned stack over-trusts fold-specific predictions).
residual_model.blend: post-hoc convex combination with the extra table adsb_full (candidate_values in tools/run_adsb_v11.py); a NaN learner value leaves the row unblended
residual_model.prediction: v9 + weight * residual on in-scope rows, then floor
residual_model.rounds_rule: development: rounds per held-out month and variant (scope, feature set) come from a 5-fold day-grouped inner split of the two training months (median best iteration, 200 rounds patience, at most 4000); the held-out month is never used for rounds; export: median of the selected variant's three development round counts

scopes.all_no_lirf: every departure at any airport except LIRF: a blend scope only (unmatched rows there become (1 - w) * v9 + w * adsb_full)
scopes.matched_no_lirf: departures with a matched ADS-B surface segment at any airport except LIRF (adsb_matched == 1 and airport != LIRF): the residual model's training and prediction scope (exactly v12)

configuration.selection: For each candidate (blend weight w, blend scope), RMSE of the blended prediction on each held-out month versus the v12 development prediction on the same rows (all departures of the month). A candidate is eligible when it is not worse than v12 on ANY month (ratio <= 1.0) and its mean ratio over the three months is at most 0.997. Choose the eligible candidate with the lowest mean ratio to v12; otherwise select nothing. Ratios to v9, per-airport tables and the paired-day bootstrap interval of the RMSE difference to v12 are descriptive only.
